sql.attachment.getAttachmentById: SELECT a.id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.archived, src.source_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN brs.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id WHERE a.id = :id AND a.deleted IS NOT TRUE
sql.attachment.getAttachmentsByType: SELECT a.id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, src.source_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.archived FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN brs.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id WHERE src.attachment_source_type_id = :attachmentSourceTypeId AND a.deleted = FALSE
sql.attachment.getAttachmentBySourceAndType: SELECT a.id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.archived, src.source_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN brs.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id WHERE src.source_id = :sourceId AND src.attachment_source_type_id = :attachmentSourceTypeId AND a.deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1
sql.attachment.getAttachmentsBySourceIdAndTy: SELECT a.id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, src.source_id, a.archived FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN brs.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id WHERE src.source_id = :sourceId AND src.attachment_source_type_id = :attachmentSourceTypeId AND a.deleted = FALSE
sql.attachment.getAttachmentBySourceAndTypeF: SELECT a.id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.archived, src.source_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN brs.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id WHERE array[src.source_id] <@ ARRAY[ :sourceIds ]::INTEGER[] AND src.attachment_source_type_id = :attachmentSourceTypeId AND a.deleted = FALSE
sql.attachment.create: INSERT INTO flow.attachment (filename, content_type, s3_key, size, date_created, created_by_id) VALUES (:filename, :contentType, :key, :size, now(), :createdById)
sql.attachment.addToJoinTable: INSERT INTO brs.attachment_source (attachment_id, source_id, attachment_source_type_id) VALUES (:attachmentId, :sourceId, :attachmentSourceTypeId)
sql.attachment.deleteReimbursementBySourceAn: DELETE FROM brs.attachment_source WHERE source_id = :sourceId AND attachment_source_type_id = :attachmentSourceTypeId
sql.attachment.deleteById: UPDATE flow.attachment SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById WHERE id = :id
sql.attachment.deleteBySourceAndType: UPDATE flow.attachment a SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById FROM ( SELECT src.attachment_id FROM brs.attachment_source src WHERE src.source_id = :sourceId AND src.attachment_source_type_id = :attachmentSourceTypeId ) AS s WHERE a.id = s.attachment_id
